about: A weekly all-day series, a day given its own notes and a reminder, that change undone, the series made timed at 10:00 Los Angeles for all events, then the redo of the undo: the day is still a day of the series on its own date, so the redo goes through (x-undo-fields). On the tree with the R1 fix it is refused as stale ('no longer part of the series') west of UTC only (10:00 Los Angeles, 19:00 New York); at 00:00 UTC and 09:00 Tokyo it goes through.
